note: Provenance index for the 2026-27 research evidence store. Every source below backs at least one SourceRef in data/research/**, except the two trailing sections: 'corroborating_sources' were used to cross-check or caveat a claim without being the encoded SourceRef, and 'access_failures' record sources that could NOT be read, so the coverage gap is documented rather than silently absent.

sources.name: RotoWire Fantasy Basketball Outlook Rankings (Roto/Points)
sources.provided: The only full ordered top-150 ranking captured anywhere in this sweep. Season label is 'mixed': the page header still reads 2025-26 but the roster content reflects the July 2026 Giannis trade and 2025 draft rookies as established players. Team abbreviations on the page are medium confidence; rank order and player identity are the usable signal.

sources.name: ESPN Way-Too-Early 2026-27 Points-League Rankings (Apr 14, 2026)
sources.provided: Full ordered 1-150, re-fetched and confirmed byte-identical to the first fetch (same order, same team tags), so extraction is reproducible. Explicitly labeled 2026-27, H2H points format. Down-tiered from high to medium_high for staleness: the April publication predates the Giannis-to-Miami trade and still lists him on Milwaukee, and its Miami entries (Herro, Powell, Wiggins, Jaquez, Ware, Davion Mitchell) reflect the pre-trade Heat roster. Rank order is the usable signal; team tags are not current.

sources.name: Sports Illustrated (OnSI) Way-Too-Early Top 50 2026-27 Rankings (Jun 4, 2026)
sources.provided: Full ordered 1-50, re-fetched and confirmed identical to the first fetch. Explicitly labeled 2026-27. IMPORTANT: the page carries NO team tags at all -- the ~15 team labels that appeared in the first capture (e.g. 'Trae Young - Atlanta Hawks') were supplied by the extraction model's own background knowledge, not read off the page. Names only are encoded; no team information from this source is used anywhere in the store.

sources.name: Slamdex NBA Fantasy ADP 2026-27 (Yahoo/ESPN/Fantrax aggregate)
sources.provided: The only 2026-27 ADP found anywhere. 150 deduplicated player/ADP pairs encoded, spanning ADP 1.7 to 168.9. Daily-updated third-party aggregator whose rosters are current, which makes it the store's best corroborator for July 2026 moves -- it independently confirms Ayton on WAS, Dort on ATL, Risacher on DAL, Tobias Harris on SAS, Aldama on DAL, John Collins on DET, Grimes on LAL, Hachimura on LAC, Kuminga and Hield on ATL, and carries DeRozan and Cam Thomas with an explicit 'FA' tag. Medium tier because the per-platform numbers are scraped, not primary. TWO ENCODING CAVEATS, recorded here because ConsensusList has no note field: (1) the page's own rank labels are NOT trustworthy -- a second fetch re-numbered the same first ~130 players (Stephen Curry was labeled rank 11 in one pass and rank 111 in the other, both times at ADP 16.2). The encoded ordering is therefore rebuilt from the ADP VALUES, which were consistent across both fetches, not from either fetch's rank labels. (2) The research file records most entries in surname-only or initialled form ('Jokic', 'A.Thompson', 'Mi.Bridges'); each was expanded to a full name by resolving the source's own position+team tag against the ESPN 150 and RotoWire 150 already in the store, since abbreviated forms would not survive name normalization. Two entries ('Cam Thomas', 'Cam Johnson') were left in the source's own form rather than guessed at. One page fetch claimed 343 total entries; that could not be corroborated and nothing past ADP 168.9 was ever surfaced, so the encoded depth is the confirmed depth.

sources.name: NBA.com - Wizards, Trae Young free agency 2026
sources.provided: Added in the follow-up pass. Resolves what looked like an R2/R4 contradiction into a confirmed two-step sequence: Young declined his ~$48.97M player option and then re-signed with Washington on a straight free-agent deal worth about $212M over four years with a year-four player option. ESPN, NBA.com, Bleacher Report and CBS Sports all agree, so his signing now carries a real to_team instead of null.

sources.name: SI/OnSI - Ranking everyone on the Bucks roster post-Giannis trade
sources.provided: Added in the follow-up pass as the only sourced role commentary on post-Giannis Milwaukee: Herro as presumptive primary scoring option with higher usage, and Jaime Jaquez Jr. (a 2025-26 Sixth Man of the Year finalist Milwaukee was 'adamant' about acquiring) getting a carved-out wing role. Deliberately capped at medium tier and confidence 0.5 -- this is an OnSI fan-network aggregator, not a newsroom, and the same piece flags Herro's expiring $31M deal as making him a pre-season trade candidate. It offers nothing on Ware or Jakucionis beyond 'part of the rebuild', which is why those two notes were down-weighted.

access_failures.name: r/fantasybball community threads
access_failures.failure: Platform-level crawler block. Domain-scoped search returned an explicit 400 naming reddit.com as inaccessible to the user agent; direct fetches of www.reddit.com and old.reddit.com failed; Redlib/Libreddit mirrors returned 403 or DNS failures; a DuckDuckGo index fallback surfaced only 2019-2024 threads.
access_failures.impact: sentiment.json is deliberately empty. No stance meets the thread-URL-plus-date evidence bar, and inventing community consensus was not acceptable. Resolving this needs an authenticated Reddit path (API/PRAW credentials or a Reddit MCP tool).
